NSCameraUsageDescription: Mooove uses your camera to check your mission, like counting your squats. Images stay on your device.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Mooove doesn’t record sound. Camera images are processed without audio and only on your device.
NSMotionUsageDescription: Mooove uses the motion sensor to count your jumps when the camera can’t see you.
NSAlarmKitUsageDescription: Mooove sets your alarms so they go off even when your phone is on silent.
